comparison.objective: Turn two identical jars to read their labels and add salt from the correct jar; candidate breaks and recovers insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Object reorientation, label-based selection, and controlled seasoning versus coaxial tool use, regulated hammer impact, and tiny-fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Correct jar selected and salt added to soup versus four tangs fractured and contained with inserts and shell undamaged.
comparison.reason: Recognition and pouring are meaningfully different from impact fracture. Setup, scoring, quantity tolerance, spill limits, run limit, fidelity, and reset details are missing.
